notes.title: Update 0.1.6.1 - The key to rebinding
notes.notes:
[b]Key Rebinding[/b]
Added basic key rebinding for keyboard controls. Should help with accessibility for players with non-QWERTY keyboards.

[b]Other[/b]
Made the first couple of missions a bit brighter.

notes.title: Update 0.1.6.0 - New year, new map!
notes.notes:
[b]New Mission![/b]
Added new mission: Town Turmoil
This mission is the first mission to take place in the new "Town" environment. This environment mainly consists of streets, concrete and civilian buildings. So the perfect place to cause some Havoc!
This is also the first mission with the new "Elimination" objective type. 

[b]Balance changes[/b]
Research tree
- Updated layout somewhat
- Reduced costs of most support abilities. Most noticeable with the "Motivator" howitzer strike. 

AC20 Canister
- Improved handling and reduced recoil
	Should now be more usable with Badger

Cluster Launcher
- Grenades are now less likely to be triggered by terrain

Focus Laser
- Focus Laser should become more accurate with continues fire. This was previously bugged, but should be working now

Missile Pod
- Slightly improved damage
- Improved steering speed

[b]Other[/b]
- Minor tweaks to some visual effects

notes.title: Patch notes: playtest 0.1.5.6
notes.notes:
Minor update with some fixes. The main fix is related to the lighting system. As previously, shadows sometimes had a strange offset, especially noticeable in the tutorial mission. Should be better now.

[b]
Gameplay[/b]
Fixed lighting. Especially noticeable in tutorial mission
Minor mission rebalances, making the first missions slightly easier

[b]UI[/b]
Minor UI improvements
